title.zh: Ripple adds XRP payments to Stripe and Tempo’s AI standard in new developer kit
title.en: Ripple adds XRP payments to Stripe and Tempo’s AI standard in new developer kit

current_state.zh: Ripple updated its XRP Ledger AI Starter Kit to support the Stripe- and Tempo-backed Machine Payments Protocol, letting AI agents make one-time and recurring XRP and RLUSD payments with private-key-free wallet safeguards.
current_state.en: Ripple updated its XRP Ledger AI Starter Kit to support the Stripe- and Tempo-backed Machine Payments Protocol, letting AI agents make one-time and recurring XRP and RLUSD payments with private-key-free wallet safeguards.
